basic_profile.bio: A curious soul based in New Hampshire, fascinated by the mysteries of human connection and communication. By day, I work as a software developer, solving puzzles in the digital world. In my free time, I love exploring the nuances of language and telepathy, often diving into discussions on the Soulnexus subreddit. I'm also an avid baker who enjoys experimenting with new recipes and a passionate follower of the Indian rap scene. I usually browse Reddit late in the evening, after a day of coding and culinary adventures. Happily engaged, I often find myself bridging the gap between languages and cultures with my fiancée, who lives halfway across the globe.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in computer science, having pursued a degree in the field and honed my skills through years of work as a software developer. My interest in telepathy and communication has led me to explore various resources online, including forums and research papers, to better understand these phenomena.
